rules.falo: Use the requested unnoted item on the NPC; showing it does not consume it.
rules.sherlock: Actual successful action while the challenge is held; cannot complete by merely owning/buying the result.
rules.numeric: Answer by talking to the issuing NPC again; reading is optional; wrong answers have no penalty.
rules.hotCold: Only active master hot/cold: Feel damages 3..8 and may kill. No damage when inactive; Jorral gives/retains a bankable device.
